cards.essence: This is the energy of creation itself, the force that begins everything and is always beginning again. In you it makes what was not there before, in a shape no one else could have made. When it is moving you are more alive than at any other time: the work has light in it, something in you has to come out, and bringing it out is a joy. It arrives in its own time and leaves the same way.

glance.reading:
This is the energy of creation itself, the force that begins everything and is always beginning again. In you it makes what was not there before, in a shape no one else could have made. When it is moving you are more alive than at any other time: the work has light in it, something in you has to come out, and bringing it out is a joy. It arrives in its own time and leaves the same way.

In balance, this power has no fear of mistakes. Nothing new has ever been made without hundreds of wrong turns, so you begin before you know how it will end. What you are making will move one way and then another as it comes into the world; let it, because it has a life of its own. Your part is to be there when it happens, with a light hand, the way a midwife is there for a birth. By the time it is finished it has made you as much as you made it, and that is where the beauty is.

There are stretches when nothing comes, and they belong to this power as much as the making does. What comes next is being made in you where you cannot see it, and it needs you quiet, mostly on your own. Asking what is wrong with you is the one thing that makes the quiet last. Let it be, rest, and it comes back the way it left, all at once, carrying what it made in the dark.

iching.trigram_combination: Heaven over Heaven: the sky, and under it the sky again, with nothing that gives way. Its creature is the dragon, which sleeps the winter at the bottom of deep water, wakes in spring, comes up into the open field and climbs into the sky. The traditional character shows vapour rising off wet ground under a strong sun, and the same word said another way means to parch.
iching.reading:
You are at the start of something, and the whole of its life is still ahead of it. Everything that begins passes through four seasons: it springs up, it grows, it is gathered in, then it is tried to see what it was worth. What you are asking about belongs to the whole cycle, not to this part, so look at all four from here. Nothing is yours until it has come through the last, and that takes longer than any beginning expects.

What it asks of you is to keep going, never to force. The sky moves through the day and the night without straining, which is why it never wears out. Make yourself strong the same way, a little every day rather than all of it in one blaze. Keep the pace of what is unfolding, slow when it is slow and fast when it is fast. Before you set out, be sure who you are and where you came from, because a force this size carries you a long way in whichever direction you are facing. The one danger in it is going too far. A strength like this can burn what it has made before it has taken shape.

In the body this energy is the head. Notice where you are holding yourself now: high, behind the eyes, already looking at what comes next. A beginning is felt there before the hands get any of it. Hold yourself the way the sky moves, steady and unhurried, with nothing in it strained.
judgement_lines: Heaven begins things, and what it begins comes through whole: it springs, it grows, it is gathered, it is tried.
It goes well for the one who holds to what is true.
image_lines: The movement of the sky is full of strength, and it does not let up.
So the wise make themselves strong, day after day, and do not tire.

upper_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
upper_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: a dragon under the water, not yet to be used.
lines.reading: With the strength still under the water, this is not its time. What is in you is real, and from the surface nothing shows while underneath a great deal is moving. Brought up now, before it is ripe, it would be spent on whatever met it first. Feed it where nobody is watching, so that when it does come up it has somewhere to go.

lines.image: a dragon come up into the open field, and someone worth going to see.
lines.reading: Out in the open field, you can be seen. You have ability, though the judgement to use it is another matter, not yet yours. Be careful who you stand with, because what is like you makes you stronger and what is not wears you thin. Find the one who has walked further than you, someone with the open mind of a child, and put yourself where they can see you.

lines.image: working the whole day through, and still watchful when night falls.
lines.reading: Past the beginning, short of the height, you are in the exposed place, with the strength for the work and the whole weight of what it is for. Part of the danger is real, part of it is your own hurry to arrive, and neither is a fault. Work while there is light, then keep watch over what you have built when it goes, and nothing will go wrong.

lines.image: a leap up out of the deep, or a while longer in it, and either is allowed.
lines.reading: At a fork between the open and the deep, and for once nothing is wrong on either side. One road is seen, the other is yours alone, and both come out somewhere good. The hesitation is you checking, which is why no harm comes of this. Look at the weather before you move, because a step back here is how speed is gathered for the leap.

lines.image: a dragon up in the open sky, and the great one there to be seen.
lines.reading: Up in the open sky at last, this strength is the one that hid, kept watch and leaped, so none of it was wasted. Like draws like, and the people gathering round you have something of the same in them. What you have reached is not for you alone, so spend it on whoever it can help, because even at the height there is such a thing as late.

lines.image: a dragon climbed past the top of the sky, with nowhere further to go.
lines.reading: One step past the top, you are still going, because this strength knows only one direction. It is late and the friends who climbed with you have gone home. The regret you feel is not the failure but the turn, the one thing that brings a proud strength back down. Learn to come down the way you learned to rise, while it is still yours to choose.

gene_keys.shadow:
This energy goes flat some days, and the days go flat with it. You reach the end of one tired and cannot say what it was for. The word for it is numbness. Numbness is a feeling, though almost nobody knows they are in it, and knowing is most of the way out. You will do nearly anything rather than feel it, reach for the phone or call someone, and each works for about a minute.

Put a hand on your chest and notice what is there, even if it is nothing. Nothing is what it is meant to feel like at the start, so let it stay, with no pressure on it to change. It is not comfortable, nor is it meant to be. It is a gap, and a life needs its gaps. A bored child is not asking for a list of things to do, only for the blank to be seen, and you are the same. A fire begins as kindling that looks like nothing, then a breath on it. The flat you feel is the kindling, and your noticing it is the breath.
gene_keys.repressive: The low closes over this person. Fear enters it and freezes it there. From there it drains the surface of their days, until the shine has gone from their eyes and the bed is as far as some days get. Only they can walk themselves out, by facing the fear that froze it.
gene_keys.reactive: This person cannot bear the flat for a minute. The moment it arrives they fill every hour and call everyone they know, anything rather than feel what is there. Everything in the body says go down and be still. They go the other way, and the body pays for it.
gene_keys.gift:
Met, this energy is a fire, and what comes through you is alive the way a flame is alive. One morning the colour is back in things, and the joy has come with no more warning than sadness ever gave. With it comes something that has to be said or made, in your voice or with your hands. You take the step nobody has taken, and even when it fails you are out of the place you were shut in, which was the point.

Where it does most is a small room: a family, a few people who work together. Give it its moment and the whole room wakes. Then leave sooner than seems polite, because fresh things do not keep, and the one who lit the room can drain it by staying too long. The ones who carry this well are soft rather than hard, plain rather than shiny, because a fire is delicate and burns whoever grabs at it. Your strength is being able to be alone, trusting your own timing over anyone's.
gene_keys.siddhi:
Everything you look at is beautiful. A face, or a grey week in winter, shines with being exactly what it is, and the light is the same in all of it. It is so delicate that one word cracks it. A student once sat a whole dawn on a mountain beside his teacher, and when the sun rose he said one word, beautiful; the teacher afterwards called him a noisy fellow. The moment you say a thing is beautiful you have stepped outside it, so you say less and see more.

This is the fire when there is no longer anyone it is happening to. Even the flat days are beautiful from here, because they were part of it. All you can do is live it where people can see. Some will resent you for it, and some will come to stand in the light.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Beyond the Shell stands opposite you a second time, and this time the lows are paired with the lows, the heights with the heights. At the bottom the two make each other worse: the flat days here want to be left alone, while the lost feeling there cannot leave anything alone and starts asking what is wrong. At the top they are one thing, the beauty of a single thing and the whole it belongs to. Between them one is the thrust and the other the direction, so neither gets anywhere alone. Open it when the low has turned into worry about the low, because it knows the way home when you cannot feel one.

human_design.gate:
In the body, this energy is the pressure to make things your own way. Gate 1 is the door it comes through: the drive to put what is inside you out where it can be seen, in your shape and nobody else's. Nobody taught you the style. It is the one you had as a child, before anyone told you how things are done. When there is nowhere for it to go you are miserable, without always knowing why. When it does get out, the people near you feel more like themselves for having seen it.

From outside, doing it your way every time can look like stubbornness. What is going on is simpler: the making and the self are one movement, so asking you to do it the usual way is asking you to be someone else. The cost is that you are misunderstood more than most, and a hard word about the work lands like a hard word about you. People who carry this all their lives learn that being different was the strength all along, and that trying to be original on purpose is the one thing that chokes it.
human_design.centre:
The centre of the chest is where this pressure rises, the Identity Centre, which holds who you are and which way your life faces. It has no engine of its own, so it works by drawing rather than driving. What belongs in your life, the people as much as the work, is pulled toward it. What goes out through Gate 1 is that self showing its face. When you trust it, it sets the direction. When you do not, you end up fighting what it was already bringing you.

In about six people in ten this centre is switched on, and the sense of self stays put whoever they are with. For someone like that, what they make carries one signature all their life, and the thing that starves them is being made to work in another person's manner. They tend to think everyone should be going their way, and if they give up their own way to follow someone else's, something in the chest goes out. In the other four it is not, so the sense of self is borrowed from whoever is nearest, then let go when they leave. For someone like that, this pressure is one of the few places they feel solid. In the act of making they are somebody, for as long as the making lasts, and even where they sit in a room can change what they make.
human_design.channel: What rises from the chest has no voice of its own. Its other half is Gate 8, in the throat, the drive to bring something to others and have it count. The two make the Channel of Inspiration, through which you can put a hard thing so plainly that a stranger takes it in. This channel waits, speaking best when someone has asked to hear it, worst when it has forced its way into a room. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, what you made stays yours until it is asked for.

tarot.ring_role: This is a family of two, the smallest kind there is. The other is Ancestors Bloom, the same fire a season on, with a harvest standing round it. Here it is the first catch, with nothing to burn yet and needing nothing. There the heat has something to feed, something to give away, and what it throws off keeps only while it is going somewhere. What both know is what a fire costs: while it burns everyone gathers, when it drops to a flicker you are nobody, and forcing it back up is how you end up making bargains with yourself. Open it when the beginning has caught and you want to see what the burning was for.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Up in the sky the dragon climbs into, one face waits for it.

body.physiology:
In the body this energy is given to the liver, and the reason is spring. The liver is the organ of spring: it is the first to wake in the year, it starts the growing, it keeps the life in you moving through the whole of you. When the liver is at ease, everything in you moves. When it is tight, everything waits. It is also the part of you that plans ahead, the general of the body, choosing which way the season will go. That is the work of the creative force too. It begins the season and sets the direction. The liver is where the body does the same.

Of everything inside you, the liver alone can make itself again. Lose most of it to injury or surgery and within months it has grown back to full size, working the whole time. The energy that begins things was given to the one organ that can begin itself again. It sits under your ribs on the right side, about the size of a small loaf. Rest your hand there and you are resting it on the part of you that starts over.
body.amino_acid:
The spark you were born with has a substance in you, and the substance is lysine. You cannot make it; your body takes it in, from meat or beans, or goes without. It is the same with the fire in you. On a morning when yours has dropped to a flicker, nobody notices you, and nothing you do by force brings it back. What brings it back in you is being fed, from outside and in its own time.

While it burns, everyone wants to be near you, and what you have then is a fire with something to feed. That is the same fire a season on, gathering a harvest round it, and in your body the two are made of one thing. Push it up by will and you pay, in what you give up to keep it lit. Fed, it comes back to you on its own.

relations.unity_line: What begins here needs what it cannot give itself: ground to land on, something to feed, and a hand on the measure.

pair.teaching: Beyond the Shell is the ground this strength comes down onto, the same first act seen from underneath. Here everything drives forward and nothing receives. There nothing drives, and whatever is handed over is carried the whole way to its end. One is the force, the other the direction, and between them it is the ground that decides where the force goes. Open it when you have begun something and it will not go anywhere, because what a beginning needs next is not more force. It needs somewhere to land.

inverse.teaching: Turn the six lines over and they come back the same, one of only eight that do. A strength that is all one kind has no other face to show, no underneath, nothing waiting behind the first look. What looks back at you is the same rising you started with, so there is nothing else to open here.

programming_partner.teaching: Beyond the Shell stands opposite you a second time, and this time the lows are paired with the lows, the heights with the heights. At the bottom the two make each other worse: the flat days here want to be left alone, while the lost feeling there cannot leave anything alone and starts asking what is wrong. At the top they are one thing, the beauty of a single thing and the whole it belongs to. Between them one is the thrust and the other the direction, so neither gets anywhere alone. Open it when the low has turned into worry about the low, because it knows the way home when you cannot feel one.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Fire
codon_ring.teaching: This is a family of two, the smallest kind there is. The other is Ancestors Bloom, the same fire a season on, with a harvest standing round it. Here it is the first catch, with nothing to burn yet and needing nothing. There the heat has something to feed, something to give away, and what it throws off keeps only while it is going somewhere. What both know is what a fire costs: while it burns everyone gathers, when it drops to a flicker you are nobody, and forcing it back up is how you end up making bargains with yourself. Open it when the beginning has caught and you want to see what the burning was for.

tarot.teaching: Up in the sky the dragon climbs into, one face waits for it.

sky.teaching: the archer, a fire sign, with the arrow already off the string toward a mark the archer has not seen yet. Strength here is what has been let go, not what is being held.

immortals.teaching: The sky is doubled, so a single figure from the old stories stands for both halves. Han Xiangzi is the one with the flute. In the stories he left a scholar's house for the mountains, having no use for what could be learned at a desk, and when he played, flowers opened out of season. That is this strength in a small instrument: breath with a shape put on it, and things growing before they were due.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the peg driven into the ground so that a whole tent can stand up and take the wind, the prop under a rising fire. Even a strength that never stops needs one point that does not move.

cards.essence: This is the energy of the ground: the part of you that takes in whatever is given and turns it into growth. It refuses nothing. A seed, a stone, rain or a dead leaf, all of it is received, and what can grow from it grows. In a life this is the stretch when your work is to hold what has come to you and let it become what it is going to be.

glance.reading:
This is the energy of the ground: the part of you that takes in whatever is given and turns it into growth. It refuses nothing. A seed, a stone, rain or a dead leaf, all of it is received, and what can grow from it grows. In a life this is the stretch when your work is to hold what has come to you and let it become what it is going to be.

Carried well, it is a quiet kind of strength, the strength of being able to bear a thing without needing to change it first. Things come to you now when you stop going out to get them, so the work is to make room. What you do from trust gives everyone more, and what you do from fear takes from everyone, yourself first. The moves that matter are small, made by feel, and most of them look from outside like doing nothing.

The way is to let it come. There will be days when it feels as if you have been left behind and ought to be making something happen, and the ground has an answer to that: everything that has ever grown has grown out of it, and none of it was hurried. Stay soft, stay where you are, and receive.

iching.trigram_combination: Earth over Earth: the ground, and under it the ground again. Whatever falls on it is taken in, and whatever is set into it comes up in its own time. Its creature is the mare, who runs as far as any horse and runs behind. The traditional character sets the sign for earth beside a sign for stretching out: ground as far as you can walk, giving under every step.
iching.reading:
You have been given something to carry through, and the carrying is the whole of the work now. It is not yours to start, because it was started before it reached you, and it is not yours to steer. What it asks is the strength of the mare: she can run as far as any horse and still she runs behind, along the ground, going where it goes. Set out in front and the way is lost at once. Come behind, and the one worth following shows.

What you are carrying has a whole life ahead of it, from its first showing to its last test, and your part belongs to all of that, not to this stretch alone. Keep to your own kind while it lasts, the ones who grow things and wait for them. The ones who charge ahead you will lose for a while, and losing them is part of it. Soft at rest, firm the moment it moves: that is how the ground is, and how you can be. Rest in what is steady and it goes well.

In the body this energy is the belly, the soft front of you that takes in what it is given and carries the weight without ever being told how. Notice where you are holding yourself now. Let the belly go, sit as the ground sits, and hold to what was handed to you until it is done.
judgement_lines: The Receptive. From the source it goes through and grows. Holding firm the way a mare does brings it through.
Set out to lead and you go astray. Follow, and you find the one worth following.
Friends in the south and west. Friends lost in the north and east. Rest in what is steady, and it goes well.
image_lines: The ground lies open under all things. That is the earth's power.
So the wise make themselves broad, and carry the world.

upper_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
upper_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lower_trigram.name: Earth (K'un)
lower_trigram.nature: Surface of the world, support of all existence. Essential Yin. Rest, receptivity.

lines.image: frost underfoot, and the hard ice still to come.
lines.reading: Frost underfoot is the first sign of the ice, and it is only frost. Nothing is hard yet, nothing is dangerous, and what will set later is still soft enough to turn. Small things gather here the way cold does, a little each night until one morning they will not break. Notice the small thing while it is small, and take care from the first step.

lines.image: straight, square and wide, with nothing rehearsed.
lines.reading: Straight, square and wide: this is what the ground does when it simply acts as itself. Nothing here was rehearsed and nothing needs repeating. When you act from what you are, the act comes out straight, keeps its own shape, leaves nobody out, and is right everywhere at once. Trying to improve on it would spoil it. Do the plain thing once, as yourself, and let others fall in behind.

lines.image: a gift kept under the coat, and another's work brought to its end.
lines.reading: A gift kept under the coat, and someone else's work brought to its end. You are good at this and the time to show it has not come. If the work belongs to someone above you, do it well and let the credit be theirs. Keep what you know behind a closed mouth. See it through without a word about your part, and keep the quiet of having done it.

lines.image: the sack tied shut at the neck.
lines.reading: The sack tied at the neck, with one emptiness on both sides of the knot. Nothing you think gets out and nothing from outside gets in. Nobody will blame you for it and nobody will praise you, which for now is exactly right. This is a closed season, when the wise keep to themselves. Keep your plans where they are, and the knot will come loose in its own time.

lines.image: the yellow garment worn low, under the rest.
lines.reading: A yellow garment worn low, under the rest. Yellow is the colour of the ground and of the middle of things. You are trusted before you speak, and what is good in you shows through of itself. Having to say what you are is the sign that you are not it yet. Wear the good thing low, and let the ones who belong near you gather on their own.

lines.image: two dragons fighting in the open country, and blood on the ground in the colours of sky and earth.
lines.reading: Two dragons fighting in the field, their blood on the grass in two colours, the dark of the sky and the yellow of the earth. What gave way has gone hard, wanting to be obeyed instead of obeying, and both sides bleed for it. The way runs out here. If you have set out to rule what you were made to receive, stop now, before more is torn away.

gene_keys.shadow:
This energy has a low, and the low is the feeling of having stepped off the world. You stand on the same ground as everyone else and it does not seem to hold you. Somewhere a wrong turn was taken, you cannot say where, and since then you have been out of place in every room. Most often it comes out as busyness: the days fill, the load goes onto your shoulders, and the hands stay moving so the hollow underneath cannot be heard. The usual move is to change the outside, a new plan or a new town, and the relief lasts about as long as the unpacking.

You have never left the ground. You cannot, and no turn you took was wrong. The feeling is real as a feeling and false as a fact. It changes the moment it is felt all the way through instead of outrun. Let it soak in, the way rain soaks into a field. What you were running from was the longing for home, and the longing is the first sign of the way back.
gene_keys.repressive: This person has let go of the thread. Nothing larger is expected any more, so they follow whatever serves them this week and call the flatness being sensible. With no felt tie to anything beyond their own life, the days have no point they could name, and they get through them.
gene_keys.reactive: Here is someone who lays a grid over life. A system for everything, a rule for every hour, whatever promises to hold chaos still. It looks like order and runs on old anger. The grid keeps the lost feeling at a distance without touching it, and the harder life pushes, the tighter it is drawn.
gene_keys.gift:
Met, this energy becomes finding your way by being carried. You stop steering and the ground begins to move you. Things start to line up on their own: the person you needed turns up, or you find you are in the right town without having planned it. None of that can be forced, because it happens when you are not looking, and it happens in spite of you. Your timing sharpens until being out of step registers in your body as plainly as hunger does, and your own face begins to show.

What you do with it for other people is the strange part. To set someone on their way you give no advice, because advice they can get anywhere. You sit with them wanting nothing from them, letting them see your weakness as much as your strength, and in your company they find out that being afraid is safe. Nothing had to be done. Harmony is catching, and a person who has stopped fighting their own life steadies the room they are in.
gene_keys.siddhi:
You are home, and you know it. The seeking is over, and it ended by finding that there was never a distance to cross. There is the ground, there is you, with no line where one stops and the other starts. Two people standing together are already a third thing, the pair itself, so there was never a two on its own. Being home is ordinary, the plainest thing you have ever felt, and it holds everything.

This is what being carried becomes when the one being carried lets go. Nothing leads now and nothing follows. Life goes on moving and you are the ground it moves over, the way the seasons move over a field. It leaves the world exactly as it is, with every mystery in place, and puts you in the middle of your life, where you had been all along.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Earth's Breath sits opposite you a second time because the Gene Keys pair these two as well. At their lowest the two feed each other. Its low season is a spark that will not catch and yours is the feeling of being nowhere, and each makes the other worse. Nothing starts because nothing seems to hold and nothing holds because nothing starts. Open it when the lost feeling has stopped everything from beginning. Something has to catch first.

human_design.gate:
In the body, this energy is the pull that gives a life its direction by receiving it. Gate 2 is where it enters: the part of you that knows which way your life faces, the way a field knows which way is downhill, by taking in what falls on it and letting it run. It does not make the road. It feels where the road already goes, and what belongs on it is drawn toward you. Asked why you are going that way, the honest answer is that it is the way, and you cannot always say more than that.

From outside, a person moved like this can look like someone waiting. Nobody can see a direction being received, so they see the not-deciding and call it drift. The cost runs the other way: the pull is to take everything on alone and settle for less than you wanted, because you did not trust that support would come. People who carry this all their lives learn to let the direction arrive, and to let the help in with it.
human_design.centre:
The centre of the chest is where this pull is felt, the Identity Centre, which holds who you are and which way your life faces. Those turn out to be one thing. It has no engine. It works like a magnet with a single pole, only ever drawing: what a life needs is pulled toward it, the people as much as the work, and the direction of the life is the sum of what it drew. When you trust it, you go where you were already being taken. When you do not, you end up at war with what it was bringing you.

In about six people in ten this centre is switched on, and the sense of self stays put whoever they are with. For someone like that there is a direction that holds across years. What starves them is walking someone else's road, and if they do it long enough they lose heart. In the other four it is not, so the self is borrowed from whoever is nearest and let go when they leave. For someone like that there may have been many lives in the one life. Place matters more than anything: the wrong house, or the wrong seat in a room, can put them out of themselves, and the right ground gives them back. For them the road is the destination, in the moment, and the only wrong turn is trying to become somebody.
human_design.channel: What this centre receives has to be worked for by something, or it stays a heading with nobody walking it. Its other half is Gate 14, low in the belly, the drive that works and makes more than one person needs. Together they make the Channel of the Beat: a direction with the power to follow it, at a beat that belongs to nobody else, and what the work brings in is usually for others as well. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the beat only sounds where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: This is a family of two. The other is Odyssey of Freedom, the self that stops imitating and shows its own face. What the two share is water. There is a sadness in water, a longing for the sea it came from. Both of you know it. Here it is the ground that lets the water soak in, and there it is the water that will not be told what shape to take. Open it when you have been carried far enough to wonder who is doing the travelling.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Three faces stand at the edge of the field the mare runs and one of them is looking for the road.

body.physiology:
There is one bone in you that everything comes to and nothing leaves from: the breastbone, the flat bone down the middle of your chest, about the length of your hand. The collarbones come to its top, the ribs come to its edges from both sides, and it goes out to nothing. It holds the whole front of you together by being where things arrive, which is this energy's whole work. That is the work of the ground too: it starts nothing, everything is set into it, and it carries what it is given. The breastbone is where the body does the same.

Of everything in you it is the bone that is moved by everything and moves nothing itself. Rest two fingers in the notch at its top, between the collarbones, and breathe in. It lifts, then settles. Nothing in you can move it on purpose. The ribs carry it, a dozen or so times a minute, and have since your first breath. You are resting your fingers on the part of you that is carried.
body.amino_acid:
The trust this energy runs on has a substance in you, and the substance is phenylalanine. You cannot make it. Your body takes it in, from meat, eggs or beans, or goes without. Part of it is built into you as it came. The rest becomes what wakes you, what moves you, then the colour of your skin and hair. Trust, too, is a chemistry: it is made in you slowly, let out while you relax, never decided.

What you let all the way in goes into the body as chemistry, not as a thought, which is why the body can feel carried before you have understood a thing. As you are carried into a wider life, your own face begins to show. In you the quiet carrying and the face that shows share one substance. The more you give way, the more comes through you.

relations.unity_line: What you meet here is what the ground was made for, the force it receives and the self that grows once it is held.

pair.teaching: Earth's Breath is the fire that begins things, the force that comes down before anything can be received. These two are the first pair there is and neither makes a thing alone. That one burns. You carry what it lights. When the beginning has come and gone and something is left in your hands to bring through, you are here. Open it when the fire is up and you want the other side of it where nothing is started and everything is brought to its end.

inverse.teaching: Turned over, nothing here changes. It is one of eight that meet their own reflection and here the reason is plain. The ground has no back. Look at it from above or from below and it is the same field, holding whatever stands on it, with nothing hidden on the underside. Nothing turns up here that was not already here. What you are looking for on the far side of receiving is receiving.

programming_partner.teaching: Earth's Breath sits opposite you a second time because the Gene Keys pair these two as well. At their lowest the two feed each other. Its low season is a spark that will not catch and yours is the feeling of being nowhere, and each makes the other worse. Nothing starts because nothing seems to hold and nothing holds because nothing starts. Open it when the lost feeling has stopped everything from beginning. Something has to catch first.

codon_ring.name: Codon Ring of Water
codon_ring.teaching: This is a family of two. The other is Odyssey of Freedom, the self that stops imitating and shows its own face. What the two share is water. There is a sadness in water, a longing for the sea it came from. Both of you know it. Here it is the ground that lets the water soak in, and there it is the water that will not be told what shape to take. Open it when you have been carried far enough to wonder who is doing the travelling.

tarot.teaching: Three faces stand at the edge of the field the mare runs and one of them is looking for the road.

sky.teaching: the earth sign of the harvest, the one who sorts the grain from the straw and serves without asking for the credit. The mare's work, done in a field at the end of summer.

immortals.teaching: One of the eight stands for both halves of this doubled ground. Lan Cai He was the wanderer with a basket of flowers who sang in the street about how fast life goes and gave his coins away. He wore one shoe. Thick clothes in summer and a thin shirt in the snow, at home on any road because nothing was owned.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the smallest letter, a single stroke, the point every other letter starts from. The whole field begins as one thing received into an open hand.

cards.essence: This is the energy of a beginning, the moment something new is alive in you and does not yet have a shape. A seed lies in the ground the whole winter, alive, with nothing above the ground to say so, and that is where you are now. You can feel how real it is without being able to say what it will become.

glance.reading:
This is the energy of a beginning, the moment something new is alive in you and does not yet have a shape. A seed lies in the ground the whole winter, alive, with nothing above the ground to say so, and that is where you are now. You can feel how real it is without being able to say what it will become.

In balance, this energy takes its time. Whatever you begin, you begin on strength stored up beforehand, against ground that does not give. The first tries fail, and the failing is not the end of anything. Each one puts strength into what is coming, so what finally comes through lasts longer than anything that came easily. You make small moves and let them be rough. The ones that hold become ground for the next. There is more power in a new thing than looks possible. A shoot, when the rain finally wakes it, will split a rock.

Nothing about this is orderly, and it is not meant to be. What looks like chaos is only what a beginning looks like from inside it. There was never any chaos, only the difficulty of starting. The hard part is the not-knowing. It asks to be settled early, and settling it early is the one way to lose it. A thing pushed to be finished before its root has gone down goes flat. Build slowly and stay steady, because when the breakthrough comes it comes all at once.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Thunder: clouds built up overhead, and under them a shock in the ground, the first movement that wakes what was asleep there. The storm is full and the rain has not fallen. The traditional character is a picture: a blade of new grass above the line of the ground, and under it a root drawn longer than the shoot.
iching.reading:
A beginning is under way in you, and this is the hardest part of it. Two things have met in you for the first time, the push to move and the weight above it. The difficulty is nothing more than that meeting. The storm has built and the rain has not come down. What you have begun belongs to the whole cycle ahead of it, the growing, the gathering, the trial, not only to this rough first part. Disorder is how everything starts. Order comes after, a little at a time.

What it asks of you is to stand firm where you are. Do not set out toward the goal yet, because from here it cannot be seen. Take the loose strands of what you have and twist them into one cord you can hold. Give people real charge of the parts you cannot carry, and keep the ground you have found. Your mind leads the body the way a ruler leads a country, so set it right before anything else. Hurrying is the one thing that turns difficulty into danger.

In the body this energy is the foot and the ear: the foot that steps first, the ear that hears what is coming before the eye can see it. Notice which of the two is louder in you now. Hold yourself the way a seed holds under the ground, with the root going down while nothing shows, because the root is what the whole plant will stand on.
judgement_lines: The sprout, in the difficulty of its beginning, comes through whole: it springs, it grows, it is gathered, it is tried.
It goes well for the one who stays true.
Do not set out toward a goal yet. Put the helpers in their places.
image_lines: Clouds and thunder, the storm built and the rain not yet down.
So the wise sort the loose strands, and twist them into a cord that holds.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Thunder (Chen)
lower_trigram.nature: Arousing power emerging from the depth of the earth. Excite, influence, move, affect. The eldest son.

lines.image: a post set in the ground, the marker that will not be moved.
lines.reading: Stopped at the first step, with the ground saying no, you hesitate, and the hesitation is right. What is in you is strong and it is at the bottom, where a foundation belongs. Make one fixed point here that people can find, and keep it. Value the ones nobody counts, because they are the ones who gather. Stay on the ground you have found and let them come to you.

lines.image: a horse saddled and standing still, and riders coming who are not raiders but suitors.
lines.reading: Mounted, not moving, wanting to act without acting, you see riders coming and brace for raiders. They have come to ask for you. The offer is real, and the time is not yours yet. What is joined too soon does not hold. Let a whole cycle pass if it takes one, and do not reach for the quick answer while you are in the hard part.

lines.image: chasing a deer into a forest with no guide.
lines.reading: Chasing a deer into the forest with no one who knows the ground, you are eager and lost. What you are after is not what you took it for, and the eagerness is what mistook it. The wise read the signs and give up the chase. Going on from here brings regret. When you are lost, do not wander: stay where you are and trace your steps back.

lines.image: the same horse, and this time it moves toward the meeting.
lines.reading: Mounted and standing still again, you are sought by someone who can help, so this time the answer is yes. What has changed is not the horse but the time. Bring together what you have been keeping apart, the parts of the work and the parts of yourself. Going to find the ones who really know is the intelligent thing. Go, because there is light in it.

lines.image: the sprout full of sap, the oil in the press not yet poured.
lines.reading: Full of sap, not yet able to pour it, you have the riches gathered with no way yet to give them out. It is spreading in you and cannot shine yet. Small acts done right will prosper. Great ones will fail, because the time is early and the way out is narrow. Let the striving end here, and keep to the small things until it is time.

lines.image: the horse saddled and standing, and tears that run like blood.
lines.reading: Mounted, unable to go, weeping until the tears run like blood, you have reached the end of the difficulty with nothing left to drive the horse. The way out is in sight, you cannot take it by yourself, and that is the whole of the grief. Nothing lasts, not even this. When the weeping is done, get down from the horse and go on with what you have.

iching.symbol: Six lines, read from the bottom up, the bottom where this begins and the top where it ends. A whole line pushes and a broken line gives way. Here one whole line sits at the very bottom under two that give way, and one sits high in the fifth place with a broken line on either side. Something strong has started under a weight, and something strong holds above it, hemmed in. The middle has not settled yet.

gene_keys.shadow:
At its lowest this energy is the fear of change, and the fear closes the hands. Whatever you rely on, the people, the house, you hold as if holding could make it stay. It works for a while, since a thing held still looks like safety. The chaos you dread is rarely a storm. It is an undercurrent, a low unease that lives in the belly and never quite settles. When one of the things you hold is threatened, the unease comes up, and what it shows is not a new disorder but how hard you have been holding all along. The usual move is to find something else to hold before the old one gives way, so the fear never has to be felt. Changing everything around you does not touch it. You were made to change, and every part of you is afraid to.

The word for it once meant open space, and fear turned it into disorder. Stay with the unease where it lives and it shows what it is: a love that has not gone the whole way yet. Love a little further, and the hands open on their own.
gene_keys.repressive: One person keeps everything in its place. Fear has tightened the muscles low in the body, the breath has gone shallow, and the days are run so nothing can move. From outside it looks like steadiness. Only feeling the fear loosens it, and the more they allow, the more they find they were held.
gene_keys.reactive: Another throws the fear out as anger. A fight is picked, a plan is blown up, and the mess the fear was about is now outside where everyone can see it. It has no direction, no rhythm and no purpose. Every anger that is not owned adds to it, and it comes back.
gene_keys.gift:
At its best this energy makes something new out of what is changing, and your hands are busy with it. Clear a space and something grows into it. That is how life works, and it is how you work. You try a thing, then the same thing a little differently, the way a child sorting buttons into boxes stumbles on a new game. Most of the tries fail. The failing is not a mistake but the trying, and it goes on until one holds. What you are making is not made alone. What is around you gets in and changes the work, then changes you, so you keep updating where you stand. You can feel that it all fits before you can see how. It is the best feeling you know.

The order you are looking for is already inside the mess, the way the tree is already inside the acorn, and the work is letting it out. Keep the best version of the thing in view and give the energy to that, because this much energy with nothing to serve will drive you mad.
gene_keys.siddhi:
At its height this energy is the innocence of someone who has been through everything and opened again. A newborn has it without knowing. So does the old woman whose heart came open after a long life, and the only difference between them is that she knows. No one is in control, and the child in you has always wanted to find out what happens. The hands are open because there is nothing left to guard.

Turned loose into a fresh field, even old cattle jump like calves, and that is what this is: the joy of filling an empty space with your own dance. You know how it ends, nobody knows the road, and the road is the play. You can grieve on the outside and watch it go on underneath. What you were looking for at the heart of everything turns out to be love.
gene_keys.programming_partner: The Gene Keys set this card opposite Melt Into Perfection, the slow refining of what is already there. You bring the new thing raw. It holds the standard and cooks out what is wrong one habit at a time. Each is the other's missing half: a beginning with nothing to test it against and a refining with nothing new to refine. Open it when you keep starting and nothing keeps. What you are bringing has to pass through what is already cooking.

human_design.gate:
In the body this energy is the pressure to bring something new into a shape it can live in. Gate 3 is where it comes in: the drive that takes what has never existed and tries form after form until one holds. It can see the pattern in a mess where other people see only the mess. It runs in you as an urge to get the raw thing into some order the moment it arrives, and the order never comes in a straight line. A new thing takes time to take root, the way a child takes years before it can do a day's work, and the waiting is where you doubt yourself. The pressure is to force it early, to push too hard or speak too soon, into a world that is not ready for it.

From outside the trying looks like disorder, and you are misunderstood more than most. People who carry this all their lives learn that what they bring lands when the time is right, not before. The timing is as much the genius as the idea.
human_design.centre:
Low in the belly, between the hips, is where this pressure rises: the Sacral Centre, the strongest engine you have. It is the energy that gets up in the morning, works all day and falls asleep used up. It does not decide, it answers. Put the new thing in front of it and a sound rises before you have thought, a yes that lifts or a no that goes flat. It answers only what is actually there, never a question you asked yourself in your head.

In about seven people in ten this engine runs all the time. For someone like that, a yes to the new thing means the energy will not run out, because it renews by being used, while a start with no yes behind it burns them out. In the other three the engine is not fixed, and it runs on what is around it. For someone like that, the pull to begin may be everyone else's, taken in and made louder, so their strength is knowing when to stop. Every drive here goes through one cycle: the excitement, the jump in, then the plateau where nothing seems to move. The plateau is where people quit, and it is usually the pause before the next stretch. Whether you are finished or only paused is a question this place can answer, if you ask it as a yes or a no.
human_design.channel: The pressure to give a new thing a shape needs something to hold against, or it changes for changing's sake. Its other half is Gate 60, at the base of the body where the pressure to keep moving lives, and that gate holds on to what works. The two make the Channel of Mutation, through which change comes in bursts, never on a schedule: a seed under the ground, growing, unseen, that nothing can push. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the new thing only takes when the push and the holding meet.

tarot.ring_role: This card belongs to a family of six that hold one whole life between them. This one begins it. The others are the watching and the cutting away, then the return and the feeding, then the finishing. What the six share is a trust in what looks like a mess. The mess is where life finds its next shape. Every one of them knows it from a different point in the life. Open any of them to see that trust further along. Here it is the first breath.
tarot.tarot_resonance: Clouds and thunder, the rain not yet down: five faces wait in that weather.

body.physiology:
In the body this energy is given to the navel, and the reason is birth. For nine months everything that fed you came in at that one point, from a supply you did not make. In your first minutes the cord was cut, and the opening closed itself. From then on you did for yourself what had been done for you, on nothing but what you had been given. Just under it, low in the belly, is where the energy you started with is kept, the root that everything after grows from. Everything you have begun since has begun the same way: fed before it could feed itself, then cut loose, with only what it had been given to live on.

Press a finger straight into your navel and it meets a firm floor at once, the scar that closed the opening. Press a finger's width to either side and the wall gives, because there is only belly behind it. Rest a finger on the firm point and you are resting it on the first beginning you ever made.
body.amino_acid:
The energy that begins things has a chemistry in you, shared with its kin, and the substance is leucine. You cannot make it; your body takes it in, from meat, beans or milk, or goes without. There is more of it in you than of any other piece you are built from, about one in every ten. What begins in you is built of what you were fed, taken in from outside, none of it made by you.

Life goes on changing, and as it changes it takes with it what it has just left. In your body that is chemistry before it is anything else. What you are becoming is built of the same substance as what you were, and the change runs on what you take in. What stops changing in a body is dying.

relations.unity_line: Read alongside UL 4, this is the whole arc of first arrival, the birth that comes in a storm and the long apprenticeship after it.

pair.teaching: Veils of Knowledge is this beginning a season on. The shoot is up and does not yet know what it is. The not-knowing has moved from your belly to your head. This card asks you to wait. That one asks you to ask once and then listen. Open it when the thing has started and you have begun hunting for the reason. The two are one arrival: the push out and the schooling of what pushed out.

inverse.teaching: Veils of Knowledge is this beginning a season on. The shoot is up and does not yet know what it is. The not-knowing has moved from your belly to your head. This card asks you to wait. That one asks you to ask once and then listen. Open it when the thing has started and you have begun hunting for the reason. The two are one arrival: the push out and the schooling of what pushed out.

programming_partner.teaching: The Gene Keys set this card opposite Melt Into Perfection, the slow refining of what is already there. You bring the new thing raw. It holds the standard and cooks out what is wrong one habit at a time. Each is the other's missing half: a beginning with nothing to test it against and a refining with nothing new to refine. Open it when you keep starting and nothing keeps. What you are bringing has to pass through what is already cooking.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Life and Death
codon_ring.teaching: This card belongs to a family of six that hold one whole life between them. This one begins it. The others are the watching and the cutting away, then the return and the feeding, then the finishing. What the six share is a trust in what looks like a mess. The mess is where life finds its next shape. Every one of them knows it from a different point in the life. Open any of them to see that trust further along. Here it is the first breath.

tarot.teaching: Clouds and thunder, the rain not yet down: five faces wait in that weather.

sky.teaching: the sign of what has to die in order to change, a depth that keeps what it holds until it is transformed. A seed rots a little in this ground before it splits.

immortals.teaching: Two who began again in poor circumstances go with this card. Li Tie Guai was the healer who came home to find his body burned and started over inside a dead beggar's body on an iron crutch with a gourd of medicine. Cao Guojiu walked out of a palace in disgust at his family and in the stories became the patron of the stage. One began again in a borrowed body and the other in a chosen poverty.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the letter of life carried whole through moving water. What passes through this beginning comes out the other side still alive.

cards.essence: Not knowing is where this energy begins: the young mind standing in front of something it cannot yet make sense of, wanting to. It is the state every person is in before they understand anything, and it is honest, because a mind that knows it does not know can still be taught. It comes up whenever something new stands in front of you, a person you cannot read, or a turn in your life you did not see coming. It stays until you understand, which is never as soon as you want.

glance.reading:
Not knowing is where this energy begins: the young mind standing in front of something it cannot yet make sense of, wanting to. It is the state every person is in before they understand anything, and it is honest, because a mind that knows it does not know can still be taught. It comes up whenever something new stands in front of you, a person you cannot read, or a turn in your life you did not see coming. It stays until you understand, which is never as soon as you want.

Carried well, this mind knows what it is for. It is for understanding, for saying what it understands, never for deciding. Logic can argue either side of anything, and a mind handed the deciding argues itself into whatever it was afraid of. Being sure in the head has never once made a body feel safe. What this mind is really after is not knowledge. Knowledge is what it thinks it needs to take the unease away, and all knowledge can give is the hope of peace. Understanding is another thing, and it does not live in the head.

The pull, when something will not make sense, is to ask why, then ask again, hunting the reason that will finally let you rest. No reason ever has. One answer is replaced by the next question, and that restlessness is the whole of the folly. The way through is not a better answer. Let the asking wear itself out, keep the mind at what it is good at, and understanding comes up on its own, from lower down than the question, once you are tired enough of answers to live inside the question for a while. You will not stop thinking. You will stop asking.

iching.trigram_combination: Mountain over Water: a spring coming out of the ground at the foot of a mountain. The water is clear at its source and has no idea yet where it is going. The mountain above stops the view, stops the water spreading, so it gathers there. The traditional character shows a plant under a cover: something growing where it cannot yet be seen.
iching.reading:
Something has come up that you do not understand, and you are the young one here, at the foot of a mountain with the water just out of the ground. Everything that has ever grown was covered like this once, before it knew what it was. You are ready to learn without yet knowing what you need. The one thing you can feel clearly is the wanting to know.

What this asks of you is to go and ask. Find the one who knows the ground, ask them once, and mean it. The first answer is the clear one. Ask the same thing a second time, then a third, and you are no longer asking. You are stirring, and every stir clouds the water until nothing can be read in it. Take what you were given and carry it off without another word. Then do the plain things well while it works in you, each one through to its end, because a character is built out of small things finished.

In the body these two forces are the hand, which holds a thing steady, and the ear, which takes in without needing to see. Hold still and listen. Notice where you are holding yourself now. There is real danger under you, the danger of not knowing, so stop at the edge of it and do not go down alone.
judgement_lines: Youthful Folly. It goes through. It is not I who seek the young one. The young one seeks me.
At the first asking I answer. Asked a second time, then a third, the water is muddied, and the muddied get no answer.
Holding firm brings it through.
image_lines: A spring comes out at the foot of the mountain.
So the wise carry each act through to its end, and a character grows from that.

upper_trigram.name: Mountain (Ken)
upper_trigram.nature: Limit, frontier, stillness. Solid, steady, unshakable. The youngest son.

lower_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
lower_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lines.image: a rule at the very beginning, and the shackles taken off again.
lines.reading: At the very start of not knowing, a rule does more good than kindness. Someone sets a limit on you, or you set one on yourself, and the limit is what opens the eyes. Take it, then let it come off. A restraint kept on past its use stops teaching and starts to bind. Whoever goes on being punished learns only shame.

lines.image: bearing kindly with those who do not know, a wife brought into the house, and the son running it.
lines.reading: Here you are the one who knows a little, and the not-knowing around you is yours to bear with. Do it kindly. Take in what is soft and unfinished, the way a wife is brought into a house, because strength that bends toward the weak is what keeps a household standing. The young one you were patient with can run the place now. Let the next one take the head.

lines.image: a girl who loses herself at the sight of a man with money, and no good in taking her.
lines.reading: Somebody is latching on. It may be a person attaching to you because you seem to have something, or it may be you, running toward whoever looks strong and losing yourself on the way. There is no gain in either. What is given away that fast was never held. Stand on your own feet, and let people come to you with what they have.

lines.image: shut in with the not-knowing, and nobody near who knows.
lines.reading: This is being in the dark without knowing it is dark. You have kept company with people who know no more than you do, and the one who could have shown you is nowhere near, so the not-knowing has closed round you like a room with no window. The shame is real, and it is the way out. Real teachers do not hide from you. Go and find one.

lines.image: not knowing the way a child does not know, open and ready to be shown.
lines.reading: There is a not-knowing that is a gift. A child does not know, does not mind not knowing, asks, and takes the answer whole. That is you here, and it goes well. Stay open, let someone who knows more take you by the hand, and follow. Being unable and following the able is the plain road through. What was covered comes clear without being forced.

lines.image: striking at the not-knowing, and the line between guarding and robbing.
lines.reading: Here the not-knowing has to be struck: it has gone on too long, and harm is coming from it. Strike it, then watch which side of the line you stand on. Beating it out of someone makes you the one doing harm. A blindness can be taken away. Nobody's sight can be handed over. Keep the robber off them without becoming one, and you end up on the same side.

gene_keys.shadow:
Intolerance begins as a slant on the mind's own logic. The mind has a bad day, decides it does not like someone, and by evening it has a list of good reasons. Under the reasons is a feeling, with logic wrapped round it, and the logic measures only what it was sent to find. That is how an opinion turns into a certainty, a resentment into a conviction, until you are blind with your own reasoning and cannot see that you are. Out of reasons come blame, justification and guilt, the whole furniture of a world split into sides.

Sit alone in a room for an hour with nothing to do and it shows itself closer to home: most people cannot bear their own minds. Under all of it is fear, thrown onto other people and defended from behind an argument. Look at the other side of your own opinion, honestly, and you will find the fear it was standing on. The mind was given a job it cannot do, which is to make you safe, and no amount of being sure in the head has ever made a body feel safe.
gene_keys.repressive: One person gives up on understanding. The mind goes slack and calls itself open, holds no opinion, because an opinion would have to be answered for. They think they are slower than others. They are frightened, and the fright has emptied the thinking out. The way back is to think again, without letting it rule.
gene_keys.reactive: Another makes the mind the judge and waits for it to hand down peace. It never does, so the anger goes onto whoever was supposed to have the answers. It comes out on the smallest thing, a word out of place. Each complaint lets off a little, and none is the point.
gene_keys.gift:
Understanding is what the water does when it is finally left alone: it runs clear on its own. It has nothing to do with knowledge. Knowledge is what the mind thinks it needs to take away its unease, and all it can give is the hope of peace, which is what keeps you asking. Understanding comes after the mind has looked at a thing from every side and found that every side can be argued. It is the way a riddle with no answer is given to a mind: at the moment the mind sees its logic will never solve it, something gives. Then the answer arrives as a feeling in the whole of you, up through the body from the belly, and the question is finished with.

The mind is let off the job of settling your life, which it was never fit for, and set free for what it loves: looking at patterns, turning them over, playing. You see both halves of any argument and take neither. You understand people the same way. The restlessness is still in you. Now it points outward, toward what could be put right in the world.
gene_keys.siddhi: Forgiveness is a warmth that goes through the borders between people and finds there was never a debt on either side. Nothing was personal. The part of the mind that needed a reason for what happened has died. In its place is a plainness that watches the old story and does not pick it up. There is nothing restless left in it. You cannot do it. It comes when you are tired enough of the drama, lands like a surprise, and something in the chest that had been choked comes open. Then it runs backward, down the line of the people you came from, untying what they left tied, so that debts which stood for generations are cancelled at the source. The water has gone on past the mountain now, and anyone can drink.
gene_keys.programming_partner: Union in the Ashes is the pole set against you, the heat that goes up before a thought arrives. At their lowest the two feed each other. The flash of reaction gives the mind something to be intolerant about and the mind hands the flash its reasons. Now the heat has an argument. Open it when your reasons have started to feel hot. The whole thing may have begun below the neck.

human_design.gate:
Gate 4 is the pressure to make sense of things: the part of you that takes a pile of loose facts and finds the shape they make. It does not rest until something fits. In you it runs as a mind that puzzles at everything, that has to know how a thing works before it can leave the thing alone, and is happiest when a pattern finally closes. What it makes is an answer, and the answer is how this mind tries to make life safe. Every answer is a guess that fitted. Held as a possibility it can be dropped the moment a better one comes, and a mind that can drop its answers stays light.

From outside, a person built like this gets called a know-it-all, the one with an answer for everything, and is often wrong while sounding sure. The pull is to act on an idea the moment it arrives, before it has taken root, then to doubt yourself when it does not take. The idea was not wrong. It was early. Watch which of your answers the world goes on to prove, and let the rest go.
human_design.centre:
The Ajna Centre is where this pressure runs: the place behind the brow where what comes in gets sorted into sense. It takes the questions that press down from the crown and turns them into something usable. It stores what it has learned as beliefs and memories. It has no engine. It can see and it cannot act. What it works out has to be carried somewhere else before anything happens, and it speaks best when someone has asked. The same answer is help at one moment and an intrusion at the next.

In about half of people this centre is switched on. For someone like that the mind runs all the time, cannot be turned off, and that is the design. They are also built to feel sure. The sureness is both a ground and a trap, because they can be sure while being wrong. In the other half it is not, so there is no fixed way of making sense of things: they take in the thinking of whoever is near and make it louder, then let it go when that person leaves. Someone like that is not built to be certain. Gripping a thought to feel steady is like gripping a steering wheel too hard. The harder the grip, the less of the road can be felt. Held lightly, a mind like that sees a thing from more sides than a fixed one ever will.
human_design.channel: An answer with nothing to test it stays a guess. Its other half is Gate 63 at the crown, the pressure of a doubt that will not accept a thing as finished, and the two make the Channel of Logic. The question presses down, the answer forms, the question checks it, and so on until something can be relied on. It is slow wiring, and it waits to be asked before it speaks. Whether the other half sits in you or in someone near you, the checking only happens where the two meet.

tarot.ring_role: Four make up this family that works out how people manage to be together. One is the yes that goes all the way in. Another is the closeness that breaks through a guard, and the third is the gathering that gives a crowd its shape. This one is the mind in the middle of it. It is the part of a bond that wants reasons and has to learn to do without them. What the four share is union. Here it is the reason nobody had to give.
tarot.tarot_resonance: A spring under a mountain draws a crowd of faces, and most of them are teachers.

body.physiology:
The neocortex is where this energy lives in you, and the reason is youth. It is the thin folded sheet over the outside of your brain, the newest part of it in the history of animals, and the last part of you to finish: the front of it, where your judgement is made, is still being wired into your middle twenties. Everything it knows it took in from outside you. It is where your words are made, and every reason you have ever given for anything. That is the young mind's work in you too. It asks, takes in, holds what it was given. The neocortex is where your body does the same.

What this layer of you has learned it cannot put down. Look at any word on this page and you cannot see it as marks. The meaning arrives before you can stop it, in a fraction of a second, doing what took you years to learn. Now try to un-read it. That is the first answer, gone into you, and there is no asking it out again.
body.amino_acid:
The mind that cannot leave a question alone has a substance in you, and the substance is valine. You cannot make it. Your body takes it in, from milk or meat, beans or oats, or goes without, and when it builds a protein it folds valine into the middle, away from the water. The change this energy is moving toward is written in you there too: a child born with it has a mind that does not run riot, from the first day.

The reasons you give for not being able to bear someone are made of the same substance in you as the closeness that gets through a guard and the yes that goes all the way in: one chemistry in you for how people manage to be together. Take this energy out of you and there would be no reasons between you and anyone, no expectations and no blame.

relations.unity_line: The company here is a schoolroom, the one who has just arrived and the one who cannot help reacting and the family that has to learn to live together, with the teachers on the wall.

pair.teaching: Messengers of the Infinite is the season before this one, the push out of the ground that had no idea what it was pushing toward. Here the shoot is up and asking. Back there the whole strain was still below the surface and nobody could be asked anything. Turn either card over and you get the other. Open it when the question has gone quiet and something in you has started pushing again with no name on it.

inverse.teaching: Messengers of the Infinite is the season before this one, the push out of the ground that had no idea what it was pushing toward. Here the shoot is up and asking. Back there the whole strain was still below the surface and nobody could be asked anything. Turn either card over and you get the other. Open it when the question has gone quiet and something in you has started pushing again with no name on it.

programming_partner.teaching: Union in the Ashes is the pole set against you, the heat that goes up before a thought arrives. At their lowest the two feed each other. The flash of reaction gives the mind something to be intolerant about and the mind hands the flash its reasons. Now the heat has an argument. Open it when your reasons have started to feel hot. The whole thing may have begun below the neck.

codon_ring.name: Ring of Union
codon_ring.teaching: Four make up this family that works out how people manage to be together. One is the yes that goes all the way in. Another is the closeness that breaks through a guard, and the third is the gathering that gives a crowd its shape. This one is the mind in the middle of it. It is the part of a bond that wants reasons and has to learn to do without them. What the four share is union. Here it is the reason nobody had to give.

tarot.teaching: A spring under a mountain draws a crowd of faces, and most of them are teachers.

sky.teaching: the twins, the sign of the two-sided mind that talks to itself and asks and asks. Two answers held at once until the truer one shows.

immortals.teaching: Two immortals stand here. Zhang Guo Lao rode a white donkey facing backwards, watching the road he had already travelled, and folded the donkey up like paper at night. Li Tie Guai went out of his body and came back to find it burned, so he went on in a beggar's body on an iron crutch. One looks back at what he has learned and the other learned it the hard way.

hebrew_letter.teaching: the blade that divides one thing from another. A question cuts, and what it cuts apart it also makes clear.

cards.essence: This energy is the wait for something already on its way. It is not the waiting of someone with nothing: the strength in you is whole, and what you are waiting on is real. From inside it feels like a full sky before rain, heavy, near, not yet falling. In a life it is the space between the asking and the answer, when nothing you do will bring the answer closer.

glance.reading:
This energy is the wait for something already on its way. It is not the waiting of someone with nothing: the strength in you is whole, and what you are waiting on is real. From inside it feels like a full sky before rain, heavy, near, not yet falling. In a life it is the space between the asking and the answer, when nothing you do will bring the answer closer.

Certainty is what it becomes when it is carried well. What you are waiting for does not come when you call it; it comes when it calls you, and it will. Waiting and patience are not the same thing. You can wait either way, but only one of them rests. Act from resolve and the timing holds. Act from hurry and everything lands a beat off, however good the plan was. The pull is to check, to open the oven to see whether the bread has risen, when every opening lets the heat out. It rises in the dark with the door shut.

Let the hour come to you, and stay inside your days while it does. There will be a stretch when it feels as if nothing is holding anything together, as if the whole arrangement would stall the moment you stopped pushing. It does not stall, because you were never the one holding it. Rest where you are, stay with what is near you, and let what is coming find you.

iching.trigram_combination: Water over Heaven: the rain has gathered in the sky over dry ground and has not come down. Under it the strongest force there is stands waiting, a force that could push through anything but this. The old character sets rain above someone stopped beneath it, made to wait for what only the sky can give.
iching.reading:
You have done everything that was yours to do, and the thing you are waiting on has not moved. That is the situation, with no weakness in it. You are strong, the strength is ready, and in front of it is a danger you cannot push through by being strong: a river too high to cross today, a person who has not decided. The timing belongs to the sky, which takes no instructions. Whoever crosses the great water crosses it after the long wait, when the crossing is sure.

What it asks of you is to be sure of the thing and to stop looking for the sign. Truth is what makes the waiting hold: if what you are waiting for is real, the light stays on while you wait. Keep to the ones who can wait beside you without talking about it. Eat, drink, sit at the laid table as the wise do while they wait; the rain finds a rested person ready.

In the body this energy is the head and the ear. The head stays up and clear while the rest of you is made to sit. The ear hears the change before the eye sees it, so stop watching the sky and listen. Stand the way a farmer stands at the door with the seed in, under a sky that has not broken. Nothing about it is idle. The one move made to hurry the rain fails; every small move made while it holds comes good.
judgement_lines: Waiting. With truth in you there is light, and it comes through.
Steadfastness brings good fortune.
The time is good for crossing the great water.
image_lines: Clouds rise to the sky: waiting.
So the wise eat, drink and take their ease with a glad heart.

upper_trigram.name: Water (K'an)
upper_trigram.nature: Precipice, dangerous place. Stream, flowing water, river. Venture and fall. The middle son.

lower_trigram.name: Heaven (Ch'ien)
lower_trigram.nature: Unceasing forward movement, dynamic, enduring, untiring. Spirit power. Heaven, sovereign, father.

lines.image: waiting far out in the open country, the danger nowhere in sight.
lines.reading: Waiting out in the open country, with the danger nowhere in sight. You are far from the trouble and it is not coming to meet you, so the day's plain work is still the whole of your work. The pull is to drift closer for a look, and drifting is how a wait is lost halfway. Keep to the ordinary without a break, and no fault comes near you.

lines.image: waiting on the sand by the water, with talk going round.
lines.reading: Waiting on the sand, with the water in sight and talk going round. You have come nearer, people have begun to say things, and a little of it stings. The ground you stand on is firm, and only going after the words could move you off it. Let them run past, keep your footing, and it ends well.

lines.image: waiting in the mud at the water's edge, and trouble coming to meet it.
lines.reading: Waiting in the mud at the water's edge, with trouble coming to meet you. You went closer than the ground allowed, before the time, and now each push to get free sinks you further, drawing the ones who take advantage. Nobody sent this; you walked into it. Stop pushing, be careful, be courteous, and give the trouble nothing to hold.

lines.image: waiting in the place of blood, and a way up out of the pit.
lines.reading: Waiting in the place of blood, with a way up out of the pit. You are inside the danger now; it has cost something, and there is no winning it by strength, because you have none to spare. Someone steadier than you is near. Give way, listen, and follow them up into the light.

lines.image: waiting with food and wine on the table, the trouble still outside.
lines.reading: Waiting with food and wine on the table, the trouble still outside. In the middle of the danger there is a quiet stretch, and this is it: nothing has gone away, none of it rules you. Resting is not putting off. Eat, take the rest that is offered, and stay right in yourself, because the crossing is made from this seat.

lines.image: fallen into the pit, with three guests arriving unasked, unhurried.
lines.reading: Fallen into the pit at the end of the waiting, with three guests arriving unasked, unhurried. The place is wrong for you, and still not much is lost. Help comes now from people you did not send for, who may not look like help; some of what they carry is your own strength, handed back. Honour them as guests, and it comes right in the end.

gene_keys.shadow:
A tightness in you says that everything should already have happened, and the tightness is impatience. The reply is late, the light will not change, the thing on its way is somehow too slow.
